_comment: The mod's words (docs/modding.md, "text"): the autocross's names, and Gino's own lines. A racer's own line is the
pool's key with his racer id after it (talk.pulled_up.gino); where he has none he says what every racer says.

diner.format.about.autocross: Two flying laps between the cones, one car at a time. The quicker lap wins: no bumping, no excuses.
result.score.won.autocross: Your lap beat his between the cones. The night is yours.
result.score.lost.autocross: {name} found the time between the cones that you didn't.
talk.pulled_up.gino: Nice boat. Does it turn, or only go straight?
My uncle's sewing machine says hello.
talk.pulled_up.aggressive.gino: Five hundred pounds of Italian says you're too slow. Want to find out?
replies.accept.gino: Va bene. Try to keep up in the corners.
replies.accept.aggressive.gino: Andiamo! Don't cry when I pass you on the inside.
replies.decline.gino: Not tonight, amico. The little one needs new plugs.
street.back_on_street.gino: Gino Ferraro's Abarth is buzzing around the pier again.
